author: Ahjay Stelino
title: Ramp It Up
description: "Ramp It Up" by Ahjay Stelino (Mixkit #69; tags: Rhythmic Underscore, Corporate Music, Positive, Futuristic, Bass, Drums, Industry, Technology). Bright (highest spectral brightness of all candidates), steady ~120 BPM corporate/tech underscore. Opens with a sustained pad bed (0-16 s), the full groove enters at 16.06 s; at 50-64 s a breakdown steps up and swells into a strong hit at 64.06 s. Measured: duration 102.1 s; RMS -10.5 dBFS; integrated -10.4 LUFS; ~120 BPM (auto estimate 119.9); 3 strongest transients at 64.06, 68.31, 70.31 s; section entries at 16.06, 56.09, 64.06 s.
suggested_use: First choice. Cut 54.0-66.0 s so the build carries the logo assembly and the 64.06 s hit lands on the logo lock-up at ~10 s; fade out over the last 1-1.5 s.

measurements.bpm_note: onset-envelope autocorrelation with a 115-BPM prior; cross-checked with a comb (1-4x lag) autocorrelation on the full-energy section, octave-corrected
measurements.section_entries_note: largest rises of 2-s RMS (build resolving into a hit), refined to the nearest onset peak

suggested_cuts.why: breakdown and swell into a full hit at 64.06 s (10.06 s into the cut)
sustained pad bed swelling into the full groove entry at 16.06 s (10.06 s into the cut)
